claims.text: The proposed model outperforms the R.M.-Reader + Verifier model by 0.7 in terms of F1 score.
The Joint SAN model shows significant improvement over the baseline SAN model, achieving higher EM and F1 scores.
The proposed model achieves competitive results compared to state-of-the-art models on the SQuAD 2.0 dataset.
